'''''Tellings of the Wheel''''' is the title of two different chapters in ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series:

* The [[The Eye of the World/Chapter 9|ninth chapter]] of ''[[The Eye of the World]]''.
* The [[Lord of Chaos/Chapter 16|sixteenth chapter]] of ''[[Lord of Chaos]]''.
